role_summary: Founder (1986) and long-time executive director of MAPS; now MAPS founder and president. Founder and board member of MAPS Public Benefit Corporation, which became Lykos Therapeutics (Jan 2024); left the Lykos board after the FDA complete response letter of 2024-08-09; backed the Antonio Gracias takeover of Lykos that closed in May 2025 (company renamed Resilient Pharmaceuticals, which resubmitted the MDMA NDA in Aug 2026). Chief public voice for MDMA-assisted therapy, the "psychedelic clinics" model, licensed legalization by 2035, and "net-zero trauma by 2070".

predictions.quote: With the continued financial support of MAPS members, MDMA-assisted psychotherapy is on track for FDA approval by 2021!
predictions.paraphrase: FDA will approve MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for PTSD by 2021.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Summer 2017 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: No approval by 2021; NDA filed Dec 2023 and FDA issued a complete response letter on 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: We can essentially have psychedelic clinics opening up throughout the United States in the summer of 2019.
predictions.paraphrase: Expanded-access psychedelic clinics will open across the US by summer 2019, ahead of 2021 approval.
predictions.source_title: The journey from ecstasy to medicine: Rick Doblin's long, strange MDMA trip (New Atlas, mirrored)
predictions.resolution_note: FDA cleared MDMA expanded access only in Jan 2020; treatments began later and were limited to ~50 patients at a few sites.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: Doblin predicted that MDMA and psilocybin could now both be legal by 2021, legalized to be administered by therapists trained in psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy.
predictions.paraphrase: Both MDMA and psilocybin will be legal for therapist-administered use in the US by 2021.
predictions.source_title: Rolling Stone: Psilocybin Could Be Legal for Therapy by 2021 (MAPS repost)
predictions.resolution_note: Neither drug was approved by 2021; MDMA got a CRL in Aug 2024 and the first psilocybin FDA decision is expected late 2026/early 2027.

predictions.quote: We anticipate our U.S. Phase 3 trials will take about two years to complete, at which point the data will be submitted to the FDA
predictions.paraphrase: US Phase 3 program done and NDA data submitted by about late 2020.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Winter 2018 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: Second Phase 3 (MAPP2) finished data collection at end of 2022; NDA submitted Dec 2023.

predictions.quote: We anticipate that our European Phase 3 trials will start in the second half of 2019 or early 2020, depending on how long it takes for regulatory approvals
predictions.paraphrase: European Phase 3 trials of MDMA-assisted therapy will start in H2 2019 or early 2020.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Winter 2018 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: No European Phase 3 started; in June 2022 MAPS was still 'preparing for launching a Phase 3 trial within a year' in Europe.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: Doblin said it is entirely possible that the DEA would only be willing to move [MDMA] to Schedule 2 rather than Schedule 3, because Schedule 3 is for drugs with less than a high potential for abuse.
predictions.paraphrase: After FDA approval, DEA may reschedule MDMA only to Schedule II, not the Schedule III MAPS seeks.
predictions.source_title: How will MDMA be rescheduled in the future? You may be disappointed (Psymposia)
predictions.resolution_note: Condition not met: no FDA approval as of Sept 2026, so DEA has taken no rescheduling action.

predictions.quote: by the end of 2021, FDA will approve MDMA assisted psychotherapy for PTSD
predictions.paraphrase: If Phase 3 results match Phase 2, FDA will approve MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for PTSD by end of 2021.
predictions.source_title: TED2019: The future of psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy (transcript)
predictions.resolution_note: Phase 3 results were positive but FDA did not approve; CRL issued 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: over the next several decades, there will be thousands of psychedelic clinics established at which therapists will be able to administer MDMA, psilocybin, ketamine
predictions.paraphrase: Thousands of psychedelic clinics offering MDMA, psilocybin and ketamine will exist within several decades.
predictions.source_title: TED2019: The future of psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy (transcript)
predictions.resolution_note: Ketamine clinics number in the hundreds-to-thousands in the US, but MDMA and psilocybin are not yet FDA-approved.

predictions.quote: What we do have is exclusive use of our data for five years... Somewhere in the neighborhood of $35 million worth of profit.
predictions.paraphrase: MAPS PBC will earn roughly $35 million profit during its five-year data-exclusivity window after MDMA approval.
predictions.source_title: Boston Magazine: The Interview: MDMA-Therapy Expert Dr. Rick Doblin (MAPS repost)
predictions.resolution_note: No approval, so no exclusivity window and no sales; Lykos/Resilient had no product revenue through 2026.

predictions.quote: The next big milestone. Well, it'll be the approval, which we think will be 2022
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy will come in 2022.
predictions.source_title: Psychedelic Research and Culture: An Interview with Rick Doblin (Qualia Life)
predictions.resolution_note: NDA was not even submitted until Dec 2023; CRL Aug 2024.

predictions.quote: psilocybin is probably one year or two years behind us
predictions.paraphrase: Psilocybin therapy will reach approval one to two years after MDMA (i.e., about 2023-2024).
predictions.source_title: Psychedelic Research and Culture: An Interview with Rick Doblin (Qualia Life)
predictions.resolution_note: Order reversed: Compass psilocybin now expects an FDA decision late 2026/early 2027 while MDMA was rejected in 2024 and only resubmitted Aug 2026.

predictions.quote: we have at least a 90 percent or greater probability of obtaining statistical significance when the other people are finished the study
predictions.paraphrase: The first MDMA Phase 3 trial (MAPP1) has a 90%+ chance of reaching statistical significance on its primary endpoint.
predictions.source_title: The Tim Ferriss Show #440: Rick Doblin — The Psychedelic Domino That Tips All Others (transcript)
predictions.resolution_note: MAPP1 met its primary endpoint (p<0.0001), published in Nature Medicine May 2021.

predictions.quote: completing our second Phase 3 clinical trial in the beginning to middle of 2022 (depending on COVID-19 and the pace of enrolling)
predictions.paraphrase: MAPP2, the second Phase 3 trial, will be complete in early-to-mid 2022.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Summer 2020 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: Final MAPP2 data point was gathered near the end of 2022; topline results released 2023-01-05, about six months late.

predictions.quote: Our current timetable for the potential of FDA approval is the first half of 2023
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for PTSD in H1 2023.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Autumn 2020 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: NDA submitted Dec 2023; CRL Aug 2024.

predictions.quote: potential approval for prescription use before the end of 2023
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval for prescription MDMA-assisted therapy before end of 2023.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Bulletin Vol. 31, No. 2 (MAPS)
predictions.resolution_note: CRL issued 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: potential approval by the European Medicines Agency (EMA) around the end of 2024
predictions.paraphrase: EMA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy around end of 2024.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Bulletin Vol. 31, No. 2 (MAPS)
predictions.resolution_note: No European Phase 3 was run and no EMA marketing application was filed as of Sept 2026.

predictions.quote: MAPS may be able to reach sustainability sometime in 2024, assuming approval for prescription use is obtained
predictions.paraphrase: MAPS becomes financially self-sustaining in 2024 if MDMA is approved.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – Bulletin Vol. 31, No. 2 (MAPS)
predictions.resolution_note: Approval not obtained; both MAPS and Lykos cut large parts of their staff in 2024.

predictions.quote: Somewhere in the fourth quarter of 2023, we should have prescription access to MDMA
predictions.paraphrase: Prescription access to MDMA-assisted therapy in Q4 2023.
predictions.source_title: Driver's Licenses to Trip on Psychedelics by 2035? Rick Doblin Maps Out the Future (Psychedelic Spotlight)
predictions.resolution_note: CRL issued 2024-08-09; no prescription access as of Sept 2026.

predictions.quote: I think what's going to happen is that it will take 10 years for the culture to really move to the point where we're ready for a licensed legalization. That will be 2035
predictions.paraphrase: A licensed-legalization system for psychedelics (trained-use licenses) will arrive around 2035.
predictions.source_title: Driver's Licenses to Trip on Psychedelics by 2035? Rick Doblin Maps Out the Future (Psychedelic Spotlight)
predictions.resolution_note: Not resolvable before 2035; Oregon and Colorado run supervised-use programs but no license-based personal-use system exists.

predictions.quote: Regulatory approval by EMA is targeted for about a year or two after approval in the US
predictions.paraphrase: EMA approval will follow FDA approval by one to two years.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – June 2022 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: Condition not met (no FDA approval); no EMA filing as of Sept 2026.

predictions.quote: in preparation for launching a Phase 3 trial within a year
predictions.paraphrase: MAPS will launch a European Phase 3 MDMA trial by mid-2023.
predictions.source_title: From the Desk of Rick Doblin, Ph.D. – June 2022 (MAPS Bulletin)
predictions.resolution_note: No European Phase 3 trial launched; MAPS pivoted to training and humanitarian projects after 2024.

predictions.quote: by, I'd say early to middle 2024, we should have, if the second phase three study looks good, as we think it probably does, we should have FDA approval
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy in early-to-mid 2024 if MAPP2 is positive.
predictions.source_title: Healing the Heart of Humanity: Legalizing Psychedelic Medicine – Rick Doblin (Third Wave podcast ep. 173, recorded at Wonderland Miami)
predictions.resolution_note: MAPP2 was positive (Jan 2023) but FDA issued a CRL on 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: there'll be six or 7,000 psychedelic clinics in America, another 6,000 in Europe, and who knows another 10,000 or more in the rest of the world
predictions.paraphrase: After approval, 6,000-7,000 psychedelic clinics in the US, 6,000 in Europe, 10,000+ elsewhere.
predictions.source_title: Healing the Heart of Humanity: Legalizing Psychedelic Medicine – Rick Doblin (Third Wave podcast ep. 173)
predictions.resolution_note: No horizon given; no MDMA/psilocybin approvals yet, so the clinic count has not begun to build toward this figure.

predictions.quote: The phase three studies will have started with psilocybin
predictions.paraphrase: By the June 2023 Psychedelic Science conference, psilocybin Phase 3 trials will be under way.
predictions.source_title: Healing the Heart of Humanity: Legalizing Psychedelic Medicine – Rick Doblin (Third Wave podcast ep. 173)
predictions.resolution_note: Compass Pathways' COMP360 Phase 3 program (COMP005/COMP006) was enrolling by early 2023.

predictions.quote: Our current timetable suggests the possibility of FDA approval for prescription use sometime in 2024.
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy sometime in 2024.
predictions.source_title: Rick Doblin – The Balance at MAPS Between Public Benefit and Private Profit (Psychedelic Alpha guest essay)
predictions.resolution_note: CRL issued 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: It may cost as much over the next two years—at which time prescription sales of MDMA might cover all of MAPS PBC's expenses
predictions.paraphrase: By about early 2025, MDMA prescription sales could cover all MAPS PBC expenses.
predictions.source_title: Rick Doblin – The Balance at MAPS Between Public Benefit and Private Profit (Psychedelic Alpha guest essay)
predictions.resolution_note: No product sales; Lykos laid off ~75% of staff after the Aug 2024 CRL and was taken over in 2025.

predictions.quote: I believe that fully globalized access to MDMA-assisted therapy can lead to a world of net-zero trauma by 2070.
predictions.paraphrase: Global MDMA-assisted therapy access can achieve net-zero trauma worldwide by 2070.
predictions.source_title: Rick Doblin – The Balance at MAPS Between Public Benefit and Private Profit (Psychedelic Alpha guest essay)
predictions.resolution_note: Aspirational target; repeated at PS2023 keynote and in MAPS Bulletin Sept 2023; no metric yet exists.

predictions.quote: quite likely that FDA will indeed approve MDMA assisted therapy for PTSD, we think, sometime around April-May 2024.
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy around April-May 2024.
predictions.source_title: MAPS Executive Director Predicts MDMA Assisted Therapy Will Be Approved 'Sometime Around April-May 2024' (Dales Report, quoting Fox Business interview)
predictions.resolution_note: PDUFA date was Aug 11 2024; FDA issued a CRL on 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: MDMA will be federally approved to treat PTSD within 12 months, allowing any doctor to prescribe it.
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA for PTSD within 12 months of the June 2023 Psychedelic Science keynote.
predictions.source_title: Huge Gathering Seeks to Shape the 'Psychedelic '20s' (Filter, on PS2023 opening keynote)
predictions.resolution_note: Advisory committee voted against in June 2024; CRL Aug 2024.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: his goal of getting Food and Drug Administration approval for MDMA-assisted therapy is on the near horizon (he predicts it will happen within a year)
predictions.paraphrase: FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy within a year (by ~Sept 2024).
predictions.source_title: Rick Doblin: The man behind the 'Psychedelic '20s' (Reason Interview podcast)
predictions.resolution_note: CRL issued 2024-08-09.

predictions.quote: substantially more than a 50/50 chance the application will be approved in August
predictions.paraphrase: Despite the negative advisory-committee vote, FDA will more likely than not approve MDMA-assisted therapy in August 2024.
predictions.source_title: Don't write off MDMA yet: How the FDA got on board with psychedelics (STAT, reporting Doblin at ICPR 2024, Netherlands)
predictions.resolution_note: FDA issued a complete response letter on 2024-08-09 requesting an additional Phase 3 trial.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: he expects another company, Compass Pathways, to win the race for FDA approval with a psilocybin treatment.
predictions.paraphrase: Compass Pathways' psilocybin will be FDA-approved before Lykos's MDMA therapy.
predictions.source_title: Advocates say the push for psychedelic medicine isn't over, post-FDA rejection (WBUR)
predictions.resolution_note: Compass holds a National Priority Voucher and expects a decision late 2026/early 2027; Resilient resubmitted MDMA in Aug 2026, so the order is close.

predictions.quote: PARAPHRASE: Lykos is currently renegotiating with Trump's new FDA regime in hopes of a reversal of last year's rejection. If this approach fails, Lykos will likely have to redo their Phase 3 studies which will set approval back by at least 3 years.
predictions.paraphrase: If FDA renegotiation fails, a new Phase 3 delays MDMA approval by at least three years (to 2028+).
predictions.source_title: Lykos founder Rick Doblin on Joe Rogan (Xeia VP summary of JRE #2319)
predictions.horizon: 2028 or later if a new Phase 3 is required
predictions.resolution_note: Resilient resubmitted the NDA in Aug 2026 without a new Phase 3; FDA acceptance and decision still pending.

predictions.quote: I'm quite optimistic. But I'm also worried that the message the public might get is 'Well, RFK likes psychedelics and now it's approved.'
predictions.paraphrase: Optimistic that the Trump/RFK administration's push (RFK: 'within 12 months') will move psychedelic approvals forward.
predictions.source_title: Will RFK Jr.'s push for psychedelics help or hurt the emerging field? (AP via Military Times)
predictions.resolution_note: No psychedelic approved by July 2026, but FDA issued priority vouchers (Apr 2026) and accepted rolling filings; Doblin did not himself commit to the 12-month date.

predictions.quote: We knew the FDA wasn't saying no, just not yet. We believed the data were valid and that adverse events and clinical outcomes were reported accurately
predictions.paraphrase: FDA will eventually approve MDMA-assisted therapy on the existing Phase 3 data now resubmitted by Resilient.
predictions.source_title: MAPS Responds to Report of Progress for MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD with FDA (MAPS statement)
predictions.resolution_note: NDA resubmitted ~2026-08-09 without a new Phase 3; FDA filing acceptance and action date not yet public.
